faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CMO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CMO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: 1 Medical Officer (MBBS) - TB, 2 Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (Urban PHC), 15 Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (15th Finance Commission) (U.A.A.M.), 3 Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (PM ABHIM) (U.A.A.M.), 2 HDU - Maternal Health Programme, 2 Female Medical Officer - Maternal Health Programme and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CMO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on the date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 100000 per month for Medical Officer (MBBS) - TB, Rs. 100000 per month for Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (Urban PHC), Rs. 80000 per month and Rs. 20000 work based performance incentive (PBI) amount for Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (15th Finance Commission) (U.A.A.M.), Rs. 80000 per month and Rs. 20000 work based performance incentive (PBI) for Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM (PM ABHIM) (U.A.A.M.), Rs. 100000 per month for HDU - Maternal Health Programme.

faq.answer: MBBS, Diploma, Master's degree, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Candidates older than 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement. Candidates not appearing on 23.11.2026; no interview after the fixed date.
